rationale: Resuming growth by consuming abundant acetate, butyrate, formate, and amino acids (N and C source). Nitrogen is limiting at ~41 mM total; growth rate constrained to 0.40 /h to stay within N budget. Fermenting to acetate, butyrate, CO₂, and releasing ammonia from amino acid catabolism. Carbon balance maintained: ~484 mmol C in supports 177 mmol growth cost + 307 mmol fermentation products.
